description: This bar chart illustrates the F1 Score (%) achieved by four different variants of the MADLLM model across six distinct datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI. The horizontal axis, labeled “Dataset,” lists these six datasets in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, is scaled linearly from 60 to 100 in increments of 10, with tick marks and labels indicating the percentage values. For each dataset, there are four adjacent bars representing different model configurations: the green bar corresponds to “MADLLM”, the purple bar to “MADLLM w/o feature embedding”, the blue bar to “pool”, and the orange bar to “MADLLM w/o skip embedding”. The approximate F1 scores for each bar are as follows: for SMD, the green bar reaches approximately 93%, the purple bar approximately 91%, the blue bar approximately 91%, and the orange bar approximately 91%; for PSM, the green bar reaches approximately 97%, the purple bar approximately 96%, the blue bar approximately 78%, and the orange bar approximately 96%; for SWaT, the green bar reaches approximately 91%, the purple bar approximately 90%, the blue bar approximately 83%, and the orange bar approximately 85%; for SMAP, the green bar reaches approximately 93%, the purple bar approximately 70%, the blue bar approximately 70%, and the orange bar approximately 68%; for MSL, the green bar reaches approximately 88%, the purple bar approximately 86%, the blue bar approximately 70%, and the orange bar approximately 86%; and for WADI, the green bar reaches approximately 74%, the purple bar approximately 62%, the blue bar approximately 64%, and the orange bar approximately 69%. The bars are grouped by dataset and are not sorted in any particular order. There are no visual emphasis indicators such as shading, bolding, or annotations on any specific bars.
